=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2041-2059 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `rb_judge_manual_merge_red_check` returns 1 and skips red-check routing whenever `PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING` is non-zero. That counter (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:661-668) counts every non-completed check-run, required or not. So when a required check has already failed and an unrelated advisory check is still running, the manual-merge callers (lines 3349-3356 for merge, 3470-3480 for terminal) post `ai-review/head-gate` success and set `RB_MERGE_READY_LABEL_ALLOWED="true"` on a red head.
  WHY: With ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE=false the run ends as `manual_merge_required`: head-gate success is posted and `ai:ready-to-merge` is set on a head whose required CI failed, with no repair request, no hand-over and no alert. Stall recovery does not run the judge again on a ready-to-merge issue, so the routing is lost rather than delayed. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; there was no severity disagreement.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2052; tests/test_review_rb_judge_red_check_repair.py:506-522 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `test_manual_merge_keeps_todays_outcome_unless_a_required_check_failed` sets `FAKE_CHECKS_PENDING=2` together with the default `FAKE_CHECKS_REASON=blocking` and asserts `ROUTED=0` and `RB_MERGE_STATUS=""`. The test treats the buggy skip-routing behavior as the expected outcome.
  WHY: The test gives a green signal to the bug, and any fix that starts routing in this scenario will trip this assertion. The source rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "With a required check red on the head, the judge's `merge` is not accepted as the outcome. The run instead takes the final-CI repair path for that head, even when `MAX_AUTOFIX_ITERATIONS` and `MAX_REVIEW_BLOCKED_RETRIES` are used up, within the repair's own caps."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh `rb_judge_manual_merge_red_check` (lines 2041-2058), the pending-count early return
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: In manual-merge mode, a red required check plus any still-running check-run makes the helper fall through to `manual_merge_required`, with head-gate success and `ai:ready-to-merge`, and no diff hunk handles the "blocking with pending > 0" case. The gate `[ "${PR_CHECKS_LAST_REASON:-}" != "blocking" ] || [ "${PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING:-0}" != "0" ]` reads `PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING` from `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:661-668`, which counts every non-completed check-run. The helper does not reuse the required-checks filter pattern at `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:615-650` (`incomplete` variable) and computes no "any required check pending" count. The test `tests/test_review_rb_judge_red_check_repair.py:506-522` asserts `ROUTED=0` for the breaking combination.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:rb_judge_manual_merge_red_check, lines 2041-2059; callers at lines 3349-3356 and 3470-3480 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `if [ "${PR_CHECKS_LAST_REASON:-}" != "blocking" ] || [ "${PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING:-0}" != "0" ]; then return 1; fi`. `PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 661-668) counts all non-self check-runs with `status != "completed"`, advisory ones included. So a failed required check plus any queued or running check makes the helper return 1. The caller then posts `ai-review/head-gate` success, sets `RB_MERGE_READY_LABEL_ALLOWED=true`, and line 3489 moves the linked issues to `ai:ready-to-merge`.
  WHY: With ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE=false, a judge `merge` (or a final `fix` treated as merge) on a red head ends as `manual_merge_required`, with no repair request, no hand-over and no ERROR alert. Stall recovery does not run the judge again, so the routing is lost, unlike the `merge_with_followup` branch. The auto-merge path is unaffected because `_pr_checks_wait` polls until the pending checks finish. The test `test_manual_merge_keeps_todays_outcome_unless_a_required_check_failed` (case `{"FAKE_CHECKS_PENDING": "2"}`) asserts `ROUTED=0`.
  Suggested fix: when the reason is blocking and pending is non-zero, set `RB_MERGE_STATUS="checks_not_ready"` and return 0, then update the pending test case (about 4 lines).
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: "With a required check red on the head, the judge's `merge` is not accepted as the outcome. The run instead takes the final-CI repair path for that head."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, rb_judge_manual_merge_red_check, the pending-count early return
  Evidence of absence: In manual-merge mode (ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE=false), a red required check plus any still-running check-run falls through to `manual_merge_required` with head-gate success and `ai:ready-to-merge`. No diff hunk handles "blocking with pending > 0", and the tests assert the fall-through.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, rb_judge_manual_merge_red_check, the `PR_CHECKS_LAST_REASON`/`PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING` check. A red head with pending checks still gets head-gate success. Fix: for `blocking` with pending > 0, set `RB_MERGE_STATUS="checks_not_ready"` and return 0 (4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2052-2053; callers at 3349-3356 and 3470-3480 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The manual-merge guard rejects red-check routing whenever `PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING` is non-zero. `pr_checks_lib.sh:661-668` counts every non-completed check-run, while the blocking result at `641-647` filters failures by required check name.
  WHY: With a failed required check and a running advisory check, `_pr_checks_completed` returns `blocking` with a positive pending count. The helper returns 1, and the caller posts head-gate success and allows `ai:ready-to-merge` instead of requesting repair or handing over.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:rb_judge_manual_merge_red_check, lines 2048-2054 (guard), callers at lines 3349 and 3471; supporting evidence scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 637-647 and 661-668 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The helper returns 1 whenever `PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING != 0`, but that counter counts every non-completed check-run (pr_checks_lib.sh:661-668), while `_pr_checks_completed` already reports a settled failed required check as blocking (pr_checks_lib.sh:637-647). So line 2052 returns 1, and the caller's else branch (line 3350 for merge, after line 3471 for terminal) silently posts head-gate success and sets `RB_MERGE_READY_LABEL_ALLOWED="true"`. This defeats the docstring contract at lines 2035-2036.
  WHY: The manual-merge path has no wait and no later re-check, unlike auto-merge, so the run ends with head-gate success and `ai:ready-to-merge` on a red head. The tests cover FAKE_CHECKS_PENDING=2 and failed required checks separately, never together.
